{# Language and version dropdowns, rendered here so the target URLs can be computed from `pagename`. The data comes from html_context in conf.py, overridden per build by the Makefile via -A flags: `docs_version` is the current build's version id, `docs_versions` all available versions, `docs_languages` / `docs_language_names` the language list (comma- separated). "dev" is special: it is the working-tree build served at the site root, while every other version (git tag) is served from a / subdirectory; English is each version's root, other languages live one level deeper. docs/_static/language-switcher.js pins the widget cluster to the bottom-right corner and handles open/close interactions. #} {% extends "!page.html" %} {% block announcement %} {# Working-tree ("dev") builds carry a notice that the content is unreleased; released builds (git tags) render nothing extra. #} {%- if docs_version == 'dev' -%}
{{ dev_banner.get(language, dev_banner['en']) }}
{%- endif -%} {# Directory depth of the current page below the site root: the "dev" build sits at the root; each released version (git tag) and each non-English language adds one level. #} {%- set depth = (pagename.split('/')|length - 1) + (0 if language == 'en' else 1) + (0 if docs_version == 'dev' else 1) -%} {%- set rel = '../' * depth -%} {%- set vprefix = '' if docs_version == 'dev' else docs_version ~ '/' -%} {%- set lprefix = '' if language == 'en' else language ~ '/' -%} {%- set langs = docs_languages.split(',') -%} {%- set lang_names = docs_language_names.split(',') -%} {%- set versions = docs_versions.split(',') -%}
    {%- for i in range(langs|length) -%} {%- set code = langs[i] -%}
  • {{ lang_names[i] }} {%- if code == language -%} {%- endif -%}
    • {%- endfor -%}
{%- if versions|length > 1 -%}
    {%- for v in versions -%}
  • {{ v }} {%- if v == docs_version -%} {%- endif -%}
    • {%- endfor -%}
{%- endif -%}
